summary: Wires a visible label, an optional description and an error message to one form control. Ids, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and validation timing are handled by Base UI Field.
whenToUse: Around every Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox, NumberField or Slider that does not take a label prop itself.
To show a server-side error next to the right control (error prop, or Form errors by name).
description for what the user needs before typing: format, limits, why you ask.
whenNotToUse: Checkbox and Switch: they carry their own label next to the control.
A group of checkboxes or radios: use CheckboxGroup or RadioGroup, which render a fieldset and legend.

dos.title: Description before, error after
dos.text: The description answers questions before typing; the error appears under the control, where the eye already is.

p.label: Figma file URL
p.description: Paste the link from Share, Copy link.

donts.title: Placeholder as the label
donts.text: It disappears on the first keystroke and has low contrast. Keep a visible label.

accessibility: The label is a native <label> bound to the control: clicking it focuses the control.
description and error are linked through aria-describedby; an error also sets aria-invalid on the control.
Errors carry an icon and text, never color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
required shows an asterisk (hidden from screen readers) and sets the native required attribute, which is announced.
hideLabel keeps the label for assistive tech; use it only when the context labels the field visually (a search bar with an icon).
contentGuidelines: Labels are nouns in sentence case, no colon: "Repository", not "Repository:".
Errors name the problem and the fix: "Repository not found. Check the owner and the name."
Do not repeat the label in the description.
